the clinical features of hypertensive disease course in the liquidators of the accident at Chernobyl Atomic Power Station, the need for the development of a special approach in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of the disease.
the clinical and psychophysiological characteristics of the course in HD patients who had been exposed to ionizing radiations.
the necessity of the complex treatment of HD in those who cleaned the aftermath of the Chernobly NPP accident, with a view of the increased risk of cardiovascular complications.

the liquidators of the accident at ChNPP are characterized by a high risk of developing HD.

liquidators of the accident at Chernobyl Atomic Power Plant have clinical manifestations of stage II HD, with a predominance of the arterial type, which is accompanied by a high level of psychological tension and a tendency to develop cardiovascular disorders.
